Sleeveless gambeson in sun-bleached linen, Hammerfell-style, with bronze bracers and leather breeches—no coat, no cloak, built for the heat of endless sand and crumbling ruins.
Gondorian scout's fitted jacket in forest-green wool, ending at the hip, worn over a cream linen shirt and dark trousers; the leather belt bears three throwing knives and a waterskin.

Northern shaman wrapped in bearskin and wolf-pelt, layered over thick wool leggings and a bone-white inner tunic; the hood is lined with rabbit fur, the gloves reinforced with iron studs.

No cloak at all—just a verdigris-bronze scale cuirass over a sleeveless linen under-layer, paired with sand-tan breeches and low leather boots, Khanduras wastes style, built for agility in ruins.

Liurnian sorceress in a flowing pewter-grey travel-robe belted with silver chain, the fabric layered but light, sleeves wide and unarmored—her staff doubles as walking stick, her hood lined with silk against rain.

Athasian desert-walker in a sun-cloak of sand-tan linen draped over a sleeveless leather vest and loose breeches—lightweight scale pauldrons on the shoulders, the rest unarmored for speed and heat survival.
Leyndell knight's engraved steel cuirass in gold-washed finish, layered over a short chain skirt and wine-red wool half-sleeves; the gauntlets are articulated, the boots plated at shin and toe.

Thayan battle-mage in a fitted amethyst-purple robe over reinforced leather trousers, the sleeves embroidered with defensive glyphs—no cloak, no hood, the fabric enchanted to resist blade and flame alike.

Free-Folk raider in a bearskin cloak over layered wool and hide, thick trousers, and fur-wrapped boots; the coat is patched with scraps of leather, the hood oversized, the gloves mittened against ice-wind.
